executive_summary: Official policy reproduces end to end against primaries: the 16 Sep FOMC statement raised the target range 25bp to 3.75-4.00% by a 12-0 vote, the 16 Sep SEP median dot sits at 4.1% for end-2026 with 16 of 18 participants above today's 3.875% midpoint (CNBC/PNC read the same grid), the 7 Oct minutes say 'most participants assessed that another increase ... would likely be appropriate by year end', and the BoC held 2.25% on 2 Sep with the 28 Oct announcement + MPR confirmed at 09:45 ET on bankofcanada.ca; both blackouts are correctly dated (Fed from 17 Oct, BoC eight days before an MPR date = 20 Oct, which is why Macklem's 17 Oct Bangkok remarks are still usable). Every macro print in the driver set also reproduces: BEA Aug PCE 3.4% / core 3.0%, BLS Sep CPI 3.7% / core 2.6%, Sep PPI 1.3% m/m and 6.3% y/y (largest since Mar 2022), payrolls +29k with u3 4.2% against a +84k / 4.1% consensus, StatCan Sep CPI 3.1% with gasoline +27.8% and CPI-trim 1.8% / CPI-median 1.9%, LFS -68k and 6.5%, and the BoC Q3 BOS line about one-year-ahead expectations rising in September. Weight arithmetic is clean: every weight_breakdown sums to its weight, directions match their arrays, the age decay recomputes to +2 base / +0.75 effective for the Fed and +6 / +5.0 for the BoC, mean absolute weight is 2.77 and 2.75 (inside 2-4), and the September release split across boc-h1 and boc-d2 carries distinct facets. The previous round's double-count (Williams and Jefferson re-counted as one entry) is genuinely fixed: fed-d3 is now Jefferson's 1 Oct speech alone, with Williams left as fed-d1. The blocker is the Fed pricing block: it publishes a 79% hold / 21% hike / +5bp / 3.93 print that no live venue supports this morning and that contradicts the CME 90.6% hold figure quoted in the same note; the cited BlueGamma page reads 87% hold / 13% hike at +3bp. That is the same field that failed on 21 Oct and again on 23 Oct (24/76 against a page reading 20/81), which is why the live board has not moved off 2026-10-19; the fix is not a re-typing exercise - re-pull the SOFR-OIS block at freeze time and reconcile it against the FedWatch number the note already carries before the snapshot is frozen.

findings.issue: Fed Oct-28 block publishes hike 0.21 / hold 0.79 with implied_rate_after 3.93 (+5bp) stamped as_of 2026-10-26T08:06:49, but the cited BlueGamma SOFR-OIS page reads Hike 13% / Hold 87% / Cut 0% with a +3bp move off 3.88% (i.e. 3.91), and its own as-of stamp is 26 Oct 12:34:17Z. Three other independent reads taken today cluster at 87-94% hold, so the published 79% is reproducible from no venue, and the candidate's own note quotes a same-morning CME FedWatch print of 90.6% hold - an 11.6pp gap against the number the same block publishes. Same field failed the 23 Oct round (24/76 against a page reading 20/81); the block was re-typed, not re-pulled.

Candidate meetings.fed.pricing: hike 0.21, hold 0.79, implied_rate_before 3.88, implied_rate_after 3.93, as_of '2026-10-26T08:06:49-04:00'.

findings.issue: fed-d6 labels a Reuters news story 'Reuters (via Bowman)', which applies the via convention backwards: the Rates annex reserves 'via X' for second-hand retellings that must be down-weighted, while this is Reuters' own first-hand reporting of Bowman's remarks. The label invites the reader (and any future scoring pass) to discount a primary wire as a retelling.
findings.evidence: candidate drivers.fed.dovish[5].source = 'Reuters (via Bowman)', source_url = https://www.reuters.com/business/feds-bowman-says-theres-time-wait-see-before-any-more-action-2026-10-14; identical Reuters copy at https://www.kitco.com/news/off-the-wire/2026-10-14/feds-bowman-says-theres-time-wait-and-see-any-more-action ('By Reuters', published Oct 14 2026) carrying 'I don't feel any urgency for taking further action at this point, we really need to take some time and understand how things will evolve'.

findings.issue: boc-h1 dates the CPI repricing as '74% on 23 Oct', but the BlueGamma BoC page read on 23 Oct was 75% hike / 25% hold at +19bp. A 1pp gap inside a historical validation string, carried over uncorrected from the previous round.
findings.evidence: candidate boc-h1 market_validation: 'OIS-implied Oct-28 hike odds ~37% (14 Oct) -> 71% (19 Oct) on the CPI; 74% on 23 Oct with a +19bp implied move (BlueGamma)'; Rates_decisions/review/2026-10-23/pm-review.json finding field meetings.boc.pricing.probabilities.hike records 'BlueGamma BoC page read 2026-10-23 08:45 ET: Hike 75% Hold 25% Cut 0%, +19 bp'.

findings.issue: The BoC headline takes the top of the current OIS band. BlueGamma prints 92% (+23bp) and is quoted exactly, but rateprobability.com at 08:00 ET today prices 77% (+19.3bp), WOWA's CORRA strip on 25 Oct prices 77%, Rabobank cites 85% and Bloomberg-via-Globe 'nearly 90%'. On its own the single 92% line reads ~10-15pp stronger than the OIS consensus; a second CORRA-OIS venue beside it, the way the betting venues are already listed, would let the reader see the dispersion without averaging.
